title: Toddler in Striped Sweater in Rural Yard, 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet outdoor candid snapshot of a young toddler standing in a yard on a bright sunny day. The child wears a horizontally striped long-sleeve knit sweater, light trousers, and a soft cap tilted back on their curly hair. In the background, a laundry line with a hanging white garment is strung across the yard against a backdrop of bare trees and a sloping hillside. The low sun casts a distinct dark shadow across the ground to the right.
